        children: ["NUMA 全称是 Non-Uniform Memory Access，中文叫“非统一内存访问”。简单说，同一台机器里，CPU 访问不同位置的内存，开销不一定相同。比如一台有两个 NUMA 节点的服务器，每个节点各有一组 CPU 和本地内存，CPU 访问本地内存通常更快，访问另一个节点的内存则需要经过节点间的互连。这里的“节点”是机器内部的硬件划分，不是 K8s 的 Node。具体定义可以参考 ", _jsx(_components.a, {
          href: "https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/mm/numa.html",
          children: "Linux 内核的 NUMA 文档"
        }), "。"]
      }), _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "GPU、网卡这类 PCIe 设备也有位置上的区别。比如 GPU 挂在 NUMA 0 这一侧，而容器使用的 CPU 和内存都在 NUMA 1，涉及 CPU、内存和 GPU 之间的数据传输时，就可能多出跨 NUMA 的开销。对于频繁传输数据的任务，把相关资源分配在同一个 NUMA 节点上，通常更有利于性能。"
      }), _jsxs(_components.p, {

          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), "\n        }\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {

        }), "\n        c.handler.PluginListAndWatchReceiver(c.resource, response)\n    }\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["每收到一份列表，kubelet 就调用 Device Manager 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "PluginListAndWatchReceiver"
      }), "。这个调用不会只更新某一个设备，而是把本次响应当成资源的最新完整状态："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(m *ManagerImpl)"
          })]
        }), " genericDeviceUpdateCallback(resourceName ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "string"
        }), ", devices []pluginapi.Device) {\n    m.mutex.Lock()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 每次响应都代表该资源的完整最新状态，先清空旧视图。"
        }), "\n    m.healthyDevices[resourceName] = sets.NewString()\n    m.unhealthyDevices[resourceName] = sets.NewString()\n    m.allDevices[resourceName] = ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "make"
        }), "(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "map"
        }), "[", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "string"
        }), "]pluginapi.Device)\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, dev := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " devices {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// allDevices 保存仍然出现在 DP 清单里的全部设备。"
        }), "\n        m.allDevices[resourceName][dev.ID] = dev\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " dev.Health == pluginapi.Healthy {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 健康设备既可以被分配，也会计入 allocatable。"
        }), "\n            m.healthyDevices[resourceName].Insert(dev.ID)\n        } ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "else"
        }), " {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 不健康设备仍然存在，但不进入可分配集合。"
        }), "\n            m.unhealthyDevices[resourceName].Insert(dev.ID)\n        }\n    }\n    m.mutex.Unlock()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err := m.writeCheckpoint(); err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n        klog.ErrorS(err, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"Writing checkpoint encountered\""
        }), ")\n    }\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里的三个集合用途不同：", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allDevices"
      }), " 保存所有仍在设备列表中的设备，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "healthyDevices"
      }), " 只保存健康设备，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "unhealthyDevices"
      }), " 保存仍然存在但不健康的设备。因此："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["DP 上报 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "fake-3"
        }), " 且标记为 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Unhealthy"
        }), " 时，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "fake-3"
        }), " 还在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "allDevices"
        }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "unhealthyDevices"
        }), " 中，只是不在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "healthyDevices"
        }), " 中。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["DP 不再返回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "fake-3"
        }), " 时，kubelet 会先把这三个集合清空，再根据新列表重建，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "fake-3"
        }), " 就从 kubelet 的设备视图中完全消失了。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这也是为什么 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ListAndWatch"
      }), " 要发送完整设备列表：kubelet 的实现是“用新列表重建状态”，不是收到一条消息就对旧列表做增量修改。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h3, {

        children: "capacity"

          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), "],\n    )\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["上面省略了资源遍历、错误恢复和 NUMA 处理，但顺序很重要：先选 ID，再调用 DP，最后把 ID 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ContainerAllocateResponse"
      }), " 一起保存下来。DP 不负责选择设备，它只负责校验 kubelet 传来的 ID，并返回如何让容器使用这些设备的配置。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "真正发起 gRPC 请求的代码更简单："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(e *endpointImpl)"
          })]
        }), " allocate(devs []", _jsx(_components.span, {

          children: "string"

          className: "hljs-type",

        }), "\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// Mounts 和 Annotations 也会以同样的方式合并到 opts。"

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-literal",

      children: "分配记录和 checkpoint"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["设备列表和设备分配是两份状态。", _jsx(_components.code, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "写 checkpoint 时，这些内容会和当前健康设备列表一起落盘："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",

          children: "error"

          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "make"
        }), "(", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "map"
        }), "[", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "string"
        }), "][]", _jsx(_components.span, {

          children: "string"
        }), ")\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " m.checkpointManager.CreateCheckpoint(kubeletDeviceManagerCheckpoint, data)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["在这份源码里，checkpoint 文件名是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "kubelet_internal_checkpoint"
      }), "，目录取自 Device Manager 使用的 Device Plugin Socket 所在目录。默认配置下，常见路径是："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "/var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins/kubelet_internal_checkpoint\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["它的作用不是保存 DP 的设备清单，而是让 kubelet 重启后还能知道“哪个 Pod 的哪个容器已经分到了哪些设备，以及之前的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AllocateResponse"
      }), " 是什么”。否则 kubelet 只看到了 Pod 还在，却不知道应该把哪些设备配置交给下一次容器创建。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "源码恢复状态的关键部分如下："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(m *ManagerImpl)"
          })]
        }), " readCheckpoint() ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-type",
          children: "error"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 读取 kubelet_internal_checkpoint。"
        }), "\n    cp, err := m.getCheckpointV2()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " err\n    }\n\n    m.mutex.Lock()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "defer"
        }), " m.mutex.Unlock()\n\n    podDevices, registeredDevs := cp.GetDataInLatestFormat()\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 恢复 Pod -> 容器 -> 资源 -> Device ID 和 AllocateResponse。"
        }), "\n    m.podDevices.fromCheckpointData(podDevices)\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 根据恢复的 Pod 记录重新构造已分配设备集合。"
        }), "\n    m.allocatedDevices = m.podDevices.devices()\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " resource := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " registeredDevs {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// DP 还没重新 ListAndWatch 前，先创建空的健康设备集合。"
        }), "\n        m.healthyDevices[resource] = sets.NewString()\n        m.unhealthyDevices[resource] = sets.NewString()\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// 先保留一个已停止的 endpoint，等待 DP 重新注册。"
        }), "\n        m.endpoints[resource] = endpointInfo{\n            e: newStoppedEndpointImpl(resource),\n        }\n    }\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["注意，这里的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "registeredDevs"
      }), " 记录的是健康设备；Pod 已经分配到的设备则由 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "podDevices.toCheckpointData()"
      }), " 另外记录。kubelet 重启后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "readCheckpoint"
      }), " 会先恢复 Pod 的设备分配记录和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocatedDevices"
      }), "，等 DP 重新注册后，再用新的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "ListAndWatch"
      }), " 结果填充健康设备集合。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["源码里还有一层保护：", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "sanitizeNodeAllocatable"
      }), " 会把 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NodeInfo"
      }), " 里的扩展资源可分配数量至少调整到“已经分配给现有 Pod 的数量”。这样 DP 短暂断开或 kubelet 重启期间，已经绑定的 Pod 不会仅仅因为 NodeInfo 里的设备数量暂时变小，就在 kubelet 的准入检查阶段被拒绝。这不会让坏掉的设备恢复，也不会把设备重新分给新 Pod，只是保证已有分配能继续被识别。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "容器重启时是否一定会重新分配设备",
      children: "容器重启时是否一定会重新分配设备"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这里需要把一个容易说过头的结论纠正一下：容器重启不一定会重新调用 DP 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Allocate"
      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "devicesToAllocate"
      }), " 会先查 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "podDevices"
      }), " 中有没有这个容器之前的分配记录。如果数量没有变化，就直接返回，不再重新选择设备；", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "GetDeviceRunContainerOptions"
      }), " 随后会复用缓存的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AllocateResponse"
      }), "，把原来的设备节点、挂载和环境变量交给容器运行时。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["只有在缓存缺失、发生重新分配等路径下，Device Manager 才会根据当前的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "healthyDevices"
      }), " 计算可用设备："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: ["devices := m.podDevices.containerDevices(podUID, contName, resource)\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " devices != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n    needed = required - devices.Len()\n}\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " needed == ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), ", ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), "\n}\n\navailable := m.healthyDevices[resource].Difference(m.allocatedDevices[resource])\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["因此，DP 不再上报一个已经分配的 Device ID，源码能直接证明的影响是：它会从 kubelet 的设备集合中消失，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "capacity"
      }), " 可能减少，后续重新分配时也不会再被视为健康可用设备。但不能简单说“已有容器下一次重启必然失败”；如果 kubelet 还保留着这个容器的分配记录和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "AllocateResponse"
      }), "，它可能继续复用原配置。真正需要重新分配时，才会暴露出设备 ID 不在健康列表、可用设备不足或设备被重新选择等问题。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "总结",
      children: "总结"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ol, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "Device Plugin 的作用，是把 GPU、FPGA 和高性能网卡等节点设备接入 Kubernetes。它负责设备发现、健康状态上报，以及在容器创建时返回设备注入配置；调度本身仍然由 Scheduler 完成。"
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["整体流程可以概括成：DP 启动并向 kubelet 注册；通过 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ListAndWatch"
        }), " 上报设备；Scheduler 根据 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "allocatable"
        }), " 选择节点；kubelet 的 Device Manager 选择具体 Device ID 并调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Allocate"
        }), "；最后把 DP 返回的设备、挂载和环境变量带进 CRI 的容器创建请求。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ListAndWatch"
        }), " 里，上报 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Unhealthy"
        }), " 和直接不返回，都会让新 Pod 少分到一张设备，但 Node 上的表现不同：前者通常是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "capacity"
        }), " 不变、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "allocatable"
        }), " 减少，还能看出设备仍在但不健康；后者会让设备从 kubelet 的设备清单中消失，", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "capacity"
        }), " 也会减少。对已经运行的 Pod，当前 kubelet 可能直接复用缓存的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "AllocateResponse"
        }), "，所以不能简单说“设备不再上报后，容器重启一定失败”。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["本文给的是一个最 mini 的 fake DP，实现了注册、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "ListAndWatch"
        }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Allocate"
